cues.en: Generative models are just much harder to evaluate, and I think that's something you're really going to appreciate in this section and in the next section.
cues.zh: 生成模型難得多，這一節、下一節應該會深刻體會。

cues.en: That said, in general, fine tuning involves using smaller learning rates, and the reason is that you don't want to completely change the base model.
cues.zh: 總之，微調一般用較小學習率，因為不想完全改變基礎模型。

cues.en: You just want to tweak it a bit so it has a learned preference for the fine tuned training set.
cues.zh: 只想稍微調整，讓它學到對微調訓練集的偏好。
